note: Arm landmarks, segments and cross-sections read from the alpha of each body raster, per image side, keyed by body family and pose family. A value is present only where the silhouette contains it: rows where the arm lies against the torso are FUSED and every inner measurement over them is occluded, not estimated. Sides are never mirrored and poses are never substituted. Regenerate with `npm run measure:arms`; the numbers are reproducible from the rasters.
sideConvention: Sides are IMAGE sides: 'left' is the smaller x, matching the pose registry's shoulder-left / shoulder-right landmarks. A front-facing figure's image-left arm is its anatomical right; facing is not inferred here.

statuses.measured: Read from the silhouette (a stated rule where evidence says silhouette-rule).
statuses.partially-measured: Locates a region rather than a joint, or one endpoint of a segment is only partially located.
statuses.ambiguous: The silhouette was read and did not decide the question. No value.
statuses.occluded: The edge is not in the alpha because the arm lies against the torso or is hidden. No value.
statuses.unavailable: A prerequisite was missing. No value.

shoulder.note: Outer silhouette edge at the shoulder row — the first row at or below the neck reaching 92% of the widest painted width within 15% of figure height, the rule the accepted body rig uses. A silhouette shoulder, not the joint centre; on a pose whose upper arm lifts above the shoulder line the row moves with it.

elbow.note: Point of greatest outward bow of the outer silhouette between the shoulder tip and the wrist row (8.05px, 0.0218 of the chord). This is the elbow REGION on the outer contour, not the joint centre, which sits inside the fused upper arm; a reviewer should confirm it.

wrist.note: Narrowest cross-section (66px) in the far half of the separated segment that is followed by a widening of at least 1.12x (to 89px, the hand). The point is the axis centre of that cross-section.

extremity.note: Far end of the separated segment along its principal axis; the hand's tip.

upperArm.note: Carries a elbow endpoint that is partially-measured; the length is a bound on the segment, not the joint-to-joint distance.

forearm.note: Carries a elbow endpoint that is partially-measured; the length is a bound on the segment, not the joint-to-joint distance.

elbowBendDeg.note: Interior angle at the elbow point between the shoulder and the wrist; 180 is a straight arm. Inherits the elbow's status.

upperArmNearShoulder.note: The slice through the upper arm near the shoulder runs into the torso before it meets transparency: the inner edge is not in the alpha, so no width is read.

upperArmMid.note: The slice through the upper arm midpoint runs into the torso before it meets transparency: the inner edge is not in the alpha, so no width is read.

elbow.note: Slice through the silhouette perpendicular to the separated segment's axis at the elbow, transparency to transparency.

forearmMid.note: Slice through the silhouette perpendicular to the separated segment's axis at the forearm midpoint, transparency to transparency.

wrist.note: Slice through the silhouette perpendicular to the separated segment's axis at the wrist, transparency to transparency.

outerContour.note: Silhouette outer edge from the shoulder row to the last row of the separated segment. Samples flagged fusedWithTorso are the outline of arm-and-torso together.

innerContour.note: Torso-facing silhouette edge at each slice along the separated segment's axis where the slice met transparency on both sides (28 of 33 slices; 3 ran into the torso and are not reported).

layering.note: Alpha carries no depth. Whether this arm passes in front of or behind the torso where they overlap is not in the silhouette and is not inferred.
